newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Simon DeBartolo gets largest-ever REIT loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Simon DeBartolo gets largest-ever REIT loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, October 2 (LPC) - Union Bank of Switzerland, J.P. Morgan & Co Inc and Chase Manhattan Corp have arranged a $750 million loan for Simon DeBartolo Group Inc, bankers said.
The loan is the largest-ever syndicated loan for a REIT, bankers said.
The loan will fund operations of a real estate investment trust (REIT) created by the merger of Simon Property Group and DeBartolo Realty Corp, according to bankers.

The loan is structured as a three-year revolver, a source said. It includes a competitive bid option on 20 percent of the facility, meaning that the REIT can solicit bids from the bank group, seeking the most attractive interest rate, the source added.

That a real estate-related loan now includes a competitive bid option -- usually reserved for more-creditworthy corporate borrowers -- evidences increasing confidence in the real estate sector, according to bankers.
